name: Glint
description: Palette derived from glintpay.com's live CSS variables: indigo-navy neutral ladder (ink #0a0e1f / mirage #141b3d / burst #1f295c / astro #29367a, hue 272), electric action blue (--c-blue #3d5cf5, hue 269), cherry/malachite/usafa semantics, lilac highlight. Chroma re-anchored to those hexes on 11 Aug 2026 (Ali: the blue read dull next to the app): neutral 0.45 -> 0.85 so the navy surfaces match ink/mirage/burst/astro instead of sitting at half their chroma, primary 1.3 -> 1.35 so L 0.55 lands on #3d5cf5 exactly. Accent stays the metal gold (hue 87 at 0.78) here; the Studio copy of this theme has accent re-hued to the action blue. Density moved tight -> default (11 Aug). Card style flat -> elevated (11 Aug): flat paints the card with --muted, which the generator sets to the SAME value as --input and --border, so outlined inputs sitting on a card were invisible; elevated puts the card on --card, a step below the input chrome. Input chrome overridden to neutral 700 in dark mode (11 Aug): the generator maps card to n900 and muted/border/input all to n800, so an outlined field sitting on a card was one ramp step from its own background and read as no field at all. Primary re-mapped to primary 500 in dark mode (Ali, 11 Aug: 'the primary needs more chroma'): the dark map takes --primary from p400 (L 0.72, C 0.189), a pale periwinkle, while the app's action buttons are the saturated mid-blue that lives at p500 (L 0.61, C 0.2295) — which is --c-blue #3d5cf5 itself. Its foreground flips to p50 to stay legible on the deeper fill. Accent is untouched. PRIMARY (11 Aug, Ali: 'the primary needs more chroma'): the dark map takes --primary from p400, which sat at L 0.72 — and at hue 269 the sRGB ceiling there is only C 0.1447, so the ramp's 0.189 was already being clamped and raising chroma did nothing. Chroma at this hue is bought with darkness (ceiling 0.168 at L 0.68, 0.210 at L 0.61), so the fix is lightness, not chroma: lightness.primary -0.04 slides the whole primary curve down, putting p400 at L 0.68 where it can actually carry ~0.168. No explicit colour values — --primary stays the p400 ramp step. Its foreground is p50, matching the app's white-on-blue action buttons. Accent is untouched.
